prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: landscape illustration for the dagger-build project page in the Osixia open-source documentation.
Input images: both images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match their polished toy-like 3D cartoon materials, rounded friendly animal design, expressive glossy eyes, orange corrugated container construction, saturated orange/green accents and tactile rendering. Do not copy their island or seaside setting.
Primary request: a cheerful brown beaver builder with a broad flat beaver tail, small buck teeth, a yellow construction helmet and a simple work apron is assembling miniature orange shipping-container modules on a sturdy wooden workbench. Beside the workbench, a short compact conveyor carries the assembled container modules through a small testing arch with a bright green check-mark status lamp. This is a friendly visual metaphor for build, test, prepare.
Scene: a clean welcoming workshop, on a pale neutral solid workshop floor, with a tidy tool pegboard, a few tasteful tools and neatly stacked parts. A small leafy potted plant can add a touch of green, but the workshop is the focus.
Composition: landscape approximately 3:2, self-contained workshop diorama against a clean off-white studio backdrop, full beaver and full conveyor visible, uncluttered framing, readable when reduced to documentation-page width. Warm bright soft lighting and gentle shadows, premium charming 3D animation look.
Text: one clear physical sign reading exactly "dagger-build", lowercase with one hyphen. No additional writing, slogans, labels or tiny pseudo-text.
Constraints: absolutely no sea, ocean, water, island, beach, sand, shoreline, nautical objects, tropical exterior or palm-tree backdrop. No dagger weapon. No photorealism, flat vector style, watermark or technical diagram. Keep the recognizable Osixia orange-container visual family while making this an indoor builder's workshop.
